components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9()+\-.\s]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner
            already has the same last name and address (they knowingly share a
            household). Not persisted.
          type: boolean
          default: false
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: Franklin, George
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>':
                the upper-cased first three letters of the city, a hyphen, the
                upper-cased first three letters of the last name, a hyphen, and
                a 4-digit zero-padded per-city sequence (one more than the
                owners already in that city) assigned at registration.
              type: string
              example: PAR-FRA-0007
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>'
                where YY is the last two digits of the registration date year.
              type: string
              example: PAR-FRA-0007-M20
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 3 derived from
                the owner's own fields at creation: starting at 1, plus 1 when a
                contact email is on file, plus 1 when the owner has no namesakes,
                capped at 3. (Level 4 is reserved for tenure.)
              type: integer
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by every owner who knowingly shares a
                household (same last name and address). Assigned when an owner is
                created with 'sharesHousehold' set to true; null otherwise.
              type: string
              example: 3F2A9C1D4B6E8071
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The single value used to detect duplicate owners, formed as
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>|<householdId or empty>'.
                Two owners are the same person only when their whole identity
                keys are equal.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|jo@example.com|3F2A9C1D4B6E8071'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of the first and last name, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: G.F.
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region derived from the owner's city via the fixed
                city-to-region table (Sydney -> NSW, Melbourne -> VIC,
                Brisbane -> QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: NSW
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of owners that already existed when this owner was
                created and share its first and last name (compared
                case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners have already been registered on the
                current business day, signalling an unusually high signup volume;
                false otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the fields on
                file: 'EMAIL' when a contact email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: EMAIL
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of owners matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:
        - content
        - page
        - size
        - totalElements
        - totalPages
    PetPage:
      title: Pet page
      description: A page of pets.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:

Owners may now include an optional 4-digit `postcode`, validated against the city's region when present, and stored/returned when given — while staying backward-compatible for owners created without one.

## Where each piece of logic lives

**Format ("4 digits")** — added `postcode` to the `OwnerFields` schema in `openapi.yml` with `pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'`. This regenerates `OwnerFieldsDto`/`OwnerDto` with Bean Validation, so a malformed postcode (e.g. `"12"`) is rejected with 400 the same idiomatic way as `telephone` and the name fields. Because it's not in `required`, absence is accepted.

**Range validation (region table)** — new `PostcodeValidator` (in `rest/validation`) owns the fixed region→range table (NSW 2000–2099, VIC 3000–3099, QLD 4000–4099) and reuses the existing `CityRegion.regionFor(city)` for the city→region lookup. `isValidForCity` returns `true` for absent postcodes and for cities with no known region (the permissive default), and otherwise checks the inclusive range.

**Error surface** — new `InvalidPostcodeException` plus a handler in `ExceptionControllerAdvice` returning 400 with `errors: ["postcode"]`, mirroring the existing `InvalidTelephoneException` pattern.

**Wiring** — `addOwner` in `OwnerRestControllerV1` calls the validator right after mapping and throws when out of range.

**Persistence** — added a `postcode` field/column to the `Owner` entity and to all four `schema.sql` files (hsqldb, h2, mysql, postgres). MapStruct maps the field automatically by name, so no mapper changes were needed.

## Tests

`AcceptanceTest` (the only test class) passes — 3/3, `BUILD SUCCESS`: valid postcode stored and returned, owner without a postcode accepted, and a malformed postcode rejected with 400.
